transcript.text: Hi Diane, thanks for calling the Massachusetts RMV. How can I help you today?
My license is expiring and I want to upgrade to REAL ID. What do I need to bring?

To upgrade to REAL ID, you'll need to bring one document proving your identity and lawful presence, one document showing your Social Security number, and two documents proving Massachusetts residency dated within the last 60 days. You'll also need to visit an RMV service center in person for verification.
Diane Martin, date of birth June 9, 1969.

I've verified your identity. Your current registration for plate JK3075 is active and expires on December 6, 2026. I don't have information about your driver's license expiration date at this time. To upgrade to REAL ID, you'll need to visit an RMV service center in person with the required documents.
